title: UniswapX Intent Settlement Testnet Integration

free_tier_limits.filler_role: Permissionless, no vetting required for non-exclusive fillers
free_tier_limits.quoter_role: Permissioned, requires application + 5 beta fills + API key

paid_plan_baseline.note: No paid plan for filler access; protocol is permissionless. Gas costs are on-chain, not platform fees.

reselling_model.revenue_mechanism: Capture spread between Dutch auction start/end prices by filling intents with own inventory
reselling_model.capital_requirement: HIGH - Requires ETH for gas + token inventory on mainnet (no testnet available)
reselling_model.automation_potential: High - Artemis bot (Rust) or custom Python filler polling api.uniswap.org/v2/orders

risks: NO TESTNET: UniswapX has no testnet deployment. All testing requires mainnet capital (ETH + tokens). Violates zero-capital spirit but scaffold is technically valid.
CAPITAL REQUIRED: Fillers must hold inventory on mainnet to execute fills. Gasless only applies to swappers, not fillers.
TOS UNVERIFIABLE: uniswap.org/terms-of-service returns Cloudflare challenge. Manual review recommended before TIER1 promotion.
COMPETITIVE FILLING: Non-exclusive fillers compete on speed and price. Margin compression likely without latency advantage.
PROTOCOL RISK: Dutch auction parameters and reactor versions may change without notice.
next_steps: Manual TOS review at uniswap.org/terms-of-service (Cloudflare blocks curl)
Evaluate mainnet capital budget if pursuing TIER1 (minimum viable inventory TBD)
Prototype filler bot using Artemis reference implementation or custom Python poller
Monitor UniswapX docs for testnet announcements (currently none as of 2026-08-27)
Validate API key registration flow at developers.uniswap.org before automation
decision_rationale: Protocol is permissionless, open source (GPL-3.0), actively maintained (pushed 2026-08-24), docs accessible via curl (.md endpoints), filler role open to anyone. Meets TIER0 scaffolding criteria despite absence of testnet. Capital requirement documented as critical risk - does not invalidate technical scaffold but blocks zero-capital execution path.
